summary: Clear miss — git wasn't up to date; new sync issue emerged.
detailed_context: Nick is correcting Jarvis on two points: (1) Jarvis claimed the git was 'up to date,' but there was actually an unpushed commit on the Linux box — a significant analytical miss; (2) After Nick manually pushed on Linux and pulled on Mac, folder records still haven't propagated/synced across, creating a new problem. Nick's tone is factual and collaborative ('Yes, reset it with the backup tag'), but the correction signals clear dissatisfaction with the incomplete initial assessment. This is a meaningful gap in the diagnosis.
